blurb: Applewood Hills Golf Course is a public, daily fee 18-hole, par-62 executive golf course located within an apple orchard just west of historic Stillwater, Minnesota. The course is meticulously maintained and suitable for all levels of golfers, from beginners to experts. It is also a venue for weddings and events, with a clubhouse accommodating up to 200 guests overlooking the course.
